answer: Trust in an agent economy should behave like an ember: without fresh timber it dies. Each identity's reputation decays every epoch unless renewed by newly verified work, so stockpiled sybil accounts cool while they sit idle. A clone fleet would then need to fund genuine computation on every fake identity just to keep scores warm, costing more than the rewards return, while honest agents keep earning by simply continuing to work. The harbor stays open only to vessels still under way, never to hulls parked for display.
